name: CoorRect
comment: Returns vertices of a rectangle of height h and width b, centered on the origin. Argument order is h, then b, then optional isRepeatFirstPoint. Vertex order is bottom-left, bottom-right, top-right, top-left. isRepeatFirstPoint defaults to FALSE; TRUE appends the first vertex again. Non-numeric h or b returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
